reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000572 (the melody read from 000572a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 15); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Silas Jones Vail's dates (1818–1884) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Vail_SJ (Vail, S. J. (Silas Jones), 1818-1884); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no98084143 (Vail, S. J. (Silas Jones), 1818-1884); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silas_Jones_Vail gives born 16 October 1818, died Brooklyn 20 May 1883 (uncited). Either way long before 1955; the later year is kept; CCEH's page gives only the year 1874. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000572a.nwc).
